title: A tracked new part always keeps a default bin in the dialog
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • No part is saved in this case.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part and leave the Track quantities and cost of goods switch on.
  2. Look at the Inventory section.
  3. Try to remove the only bin row.
  4. Click Add Bin Location and pick {Bin-B} in the new row.
  5. Try to take the Default mark off the {Bin-A} row so that no row is marked Default.
  6. Try to remove the {Bin-A} row, which is marked Default.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: One bin row is already filled in: {Bin-A}, Quantity 0, with the Default pill.
  • Step 3: The only bin row cannot be removed (no remove control is offered, or it does nothing).
  • Steps 3 to 6: The dialog never lets you reach a tracked part with no bin or no default bin, so the refusals "At least one bin must be provided." and "At least one bin must be marked as default." cannot be produced from it. Those refusals come only from a request made outside the dialog: this part cannot be checked by hand; write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 5: One of the two rows always stays marked Default; the dialog never shows two bin rows with no Default pill.
  • Step 6: The row marked Default cannot be removed; both rows are still there.
  • Step 7: The dialog closes and no part is created.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S4-R7, S4-N1, S4-N2, the Story 4 context note and §8 User Feedback Summary (Tracked part saved with no bin, Tracked part saved with no default bin), read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R7: “When the switch is on, at least one bin location must be set, and one must be marked as the default, before the part can be saved.”
  • PRD Story 4 context note: “in the dialog a new part always starts with the location's default bin, and the last bin and the default bin cannot be removed, so S4-N1 and S4-N2 come from requests made outside the dialog.”
  • S4-N1: “If a tracked part reaches the system with no bin location, the save is refused with "At least one bin must be provided."”
  • S4-N2: “If a tracked part reaches the system with bin locations but none marked as the default, the save is refused with "At least one bin must be marked as default."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Tracked part saved with no bin): “"At least one bin must be provided." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Tracked part saved with no default bin): “"At least one bin must be marked as default." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
